identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase 2 Safety, Tolerability, PK, and Efficacy Study of CS-1103 Following Fentanyl Challenge With Naloxone Blockade
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Efficacy of a Single Dose of Intravenous CS 1103 Following a Single Intravenous Dose of Fentanyl in Healthy Subjects With Naloxone Blockade

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy of CS-1103 (1,000 mg), given by intravenous (IV) infusion in healthy participants in the presence of a clinically relevant dose of fentanyl (200 μg, IV), with naloxone blockade (400 μg, IV).

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants receive naloxone blockade (400 μg, IV), followed by fentanyl (200 μg, IV), followed by placebo (saline).

armGroups.label: Active
armGroups.description: Participants receive naloxone blockade (400 μg, IV), followed by fentanyl (200 μg, IV), followed by CS-1103 (1,000 mg, IV).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with CS-1103-related adverse events (AEs) assessed by physical examinations
Number of participants with CS-1103-related adverse events (AEs) assessed by electrocardiograms (ECGs)
primaryOutcomes.description: Digital 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs). Any correlation between CS-1103 plasma concentrations and changes in QT intervals will be noted

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with CS-1103-related adverse events (AEs) assessed by vital signs
primaryOutcomes.description: Blood pressure, pulse rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, and body temperature

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with CS-1103-related adverse events (AEs) assessed by laboratory parameters
primaryOutcomes.description: Clinical chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis

primaryOutcomes.measure: Time course of CS-1103 blood and urine concentrations
primaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of plasma and urine concentrations of CS-1103

primaryOutcomes.measure: Time course and magnitude of urine excretion of fentanyl
primaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of concentration of fentanyl in urine

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of CS-1103 and fentanyl on QT interval
secondaryOutcomes.description: Concentration-QT correlation performed on baseline-corrected QTcF time-matched with PK for fentanyl and CS-1103 in plasma

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of CS-1103 on the naloxone plasma and urine PK, if any
secondaryOutcomes.description: Measurement of standard urine and plasma PK parameters between placebo and CS-1103 treated participants
